summary: Gyomu Python Analysis is a comprehensive toolkit for statically analyzing Python projects, workspaces, and language constructs. It provides modular AST-based analyzers for examining classes, functions, types, Pydantic models, and expressions, alongside robust workspace initialization, configuration parsing, and project snapshot tracking capabilities.
responsibilities: Analyze Python source code structures, language constructs, and metadata.
Manage project and workspace initialization, configuration parsing, and module loading contexts.
Create, diff, and manage project snapshots to track code modifications and changes over time.
Build symbol indexes, locations, and identity contexts from source code elements.

capabilities.name: Python Language Analysis
capabilities.description: Examines Python language constructs including classes, functions, variables, imports, dependencies, docstrings, type aliases, and Pydantic models.

capabilities.name: AST Parsing and Indexing
capabilities.description: Parses Python Abstract Syntax Trees to analyze statements, expressions, and build symbol indexes and identities.

capabilities.name: Workspace and Project Management
capabilities.description: Initializes project and workspace contexts, reads configurations, manages module loading, and handles caching.

capabilities.name: Snapshot and Version Tracking
capabilities.description: Tracks file modifications, diffs changes between versions, and handles project snapshot creation, validation, and persistence.

design_decisions: Employs modular AST-based analyzers to decompose Python language constructs into structured representations.
Maintains explicit project and workspace contexts to support multi-project configurations and source root resolution.
Utilizes snapshot tracking with file hashing and modification timestamps to detect and analyze project changes efficiently.
usage_guidance: Use the workspace and project initialization modules to set up analysis contexts from project configurations.
Leverage the core analyzers and AST utilities to inspect Python source code constructs and extract symbol metadata.
Employ snapshot and diffing workflows to track modifications and analyze changes across project files.
